FULLY REFURBISHED EN SUITE ROOM TO RENT

My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this newly refurbished, furnished double room in shared house which is located on the lower ground floor and is decorated to a high standard, close to local amenities and Darlington Train Station. Property comprises of: Furnished Double Bedroom, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen/Dining Area, En Suite Bathroom/Shower. Early viewing is recommended, and is a short walk from the town centre, restaurants and bars. All Bills and Council Tax are included in the rent.
